title: Friends who fought the CIA and DNI internally

tellings.quote: Like I have friends who went to war with me against the CIA and DNI internally like went to war and said I can prove you're lying and did so.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who speaks publicly about government secrecy over UFOs, says he has friends who fought the CIA and the office of the Director of National Intelligence, the head of all US spy agencies, from inside the government, telling them they could prove those agencies were lying, and then doing so. He tells it as something he knows from the people involved.
